faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Kalyani Project Technical Support III (Psychologist) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 28th September 2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Project Technical Support III (Psychologist) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Graduation degree in science or a relevant field with three years of work experience, or a Master's degree in a relevant field from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for this post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support III (Psychologist) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 28,000/- plus HRA as applicable.

faq.question: Q5. How will the selection be done for this post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process is through email. Candidates need to send their application and documents to the official email address provided.

faq.question: Q8. Where is AIIMS Kalyani located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Kalyani is located in Kalyani, West Bengal, with the pincode 741245.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Project Technical Support III (Psychologist).

faq.question: Q10. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for this recruitment is scheduled to be held on 29th September 2026.
